questions.question: 4. What is the key difference between compile-time and runtime polymorphism in Java?

answers.a: Compile-time polymorphism is implemented using method overriding, while runtime polymorphism is implemented using method overloading.
answers.b: Compile-time polymorphism is determined during compilation, while runtime polymorphism is resolved at runtime.
answers.c: Runtime polymorphism is faster than compile-time polymorphism.
answers.d: Compile-time polymorphism is achieved using interfaces.

questions.question: 5. Which of the following statements about method overloading is true?

answers.a: Method overloading occurs only in different classes.
answers.b: Method overloading is achieved by changing the method name.
answers.c: Method overloading allows multiple methods with the same name but different parameters.
answers.d: Overloaded methods must have the same return type.
